name: singlet_demux_hashtag_sample_assignment
title: Hashtag and lipid-tag sample assignment
description: Assigns each droplet of a multiplexed pool to one sample, a cross-sample multiplet or negative, from hashtag, CellPlex or lipid-tag UMI counts, with a probability per call. Use the default singlet_mixture method once it is built; the other method values are published comparators run at their defaults. Do not use for pools without sample tags, or to find same-sample multiplets, which tags cannot detect. Writes sample, class, probability, posterior and parameter members.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Caller. singlet_mixture is the proposed model; the other values are published comparators.

tags.description: Tag feature names; default is every feature listed in uns/tag_features. At least two are needed.

normalisation.description: Input transform. clr applies only to HTODemux clustering.

posterior_cut.description: Posterior threshold for calling a tag present; used by singlet_mixture and demultiplex2.

ambient_term.description: Include the per-droplet ambient profile in the tag means.

rna_covariates.description: Regress tag means on log RNA library size.

calibration_fraction.description: Droplet fraction used to fit the probability calibration map.

positive_quantile.description: Quantile of the fitted negative distribution that sets each tag threshold.

init_k.description: CLARA cluster count; null uses the number of tags plus one.

min_prop.description: Minimum proportion used when inferring the ambient profile.

pseudo_count.description: Floor on the per-droplet pseudo-count used in log ratios.

doublet_nmads.description: MAD multiplier for the doublet threshold on the second log ratio.

doublet_min.description: Lower bound on the doublet threshold, in log2 units.

constant_ambient.description: Use one ambient baseline; required for doublet calls with two tags.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA for singlet_mixture when memory suffices.

seed.description: Random seed for EM initialisation and calibration splits.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without writing members.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: estimate only; queued: long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/hashtag_sample. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: n_droplets, class_counts (singlet, multiplet, negative), sample_counts, negative_fraction, multiplet_fraction, tag_thresholds, converged, iterations.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
